
'''Yamamoto Hachimangū''' (山本八幡宮) refers to several Shinto shrines of the Hachiman Shrine type.

* Yamamoto Hachimangū (Fujinomiya City) - Located in Fujinomiya City, Shizuoka Prefecture.
* Yamamoto Hachimangū (Yao City) - Located in Yao City, Osaka Prefecture.
